intake.title: Logical observer separation: a strict hierarchy from BF to Extensionality
intake.statement: Over H, OS entails C + BF; full typed endpoint separation is equivalent to C5 + Atomicity (type t), and full typed factive separation is equivalent to Extensionality. Over C, the strict hierarchy is Extensionality ⇒ C5 + Atomicity (type t) ⇒ ☐OS ⇒ OS ⇒ BF. Atomicity (type t) + BF implies OS. Over C5 + Actuality, OS, ☐OS and Atomicity (type t) are equivalent. Over C5, ☐OS + ◇Actuality entails ☐Plenitude; replacing ☐OS by OS does not suffice. Given OS, uniqueness of the qualified logical observer is equivalent to Extensionality. Reversible separation is equivalent to involutive separation and to its separately boxed schema, and entails C5 + ☐OS. Reversible separation together with Actuality, one atom, or one qualified observer at t with finitely many outputs is equivalent to endpoint separation. Finite-image separation is incomparable with reversible separation, C + Atomicity (type t) + BF, and ☐OS. Under C5, propositional atoms correspond bijectively to endpoint observers qualified at t. In the propositional conjunction/universal fragment, requiring jointly qualified observers is strictly stronger over H than requiring separate separating classes. Over C, universal separation and joint separation are equivalent to the corresponding unboxed BF instances for each finite type list. Over C, each singleton connective-preservation separation principle holds, while any two of conjunction, disjunction and negation preserved by the same observers give Boolean separation. Top-accepting identity-fixing separation at t is exactly ND (type t); adjoining universal preservation at the finite list Δ gives ND (type t) + BF at Δ, hence C5 when t belongs to Δ. Over C, an endpoint-fixing operator with range {⊤,⊥} exists exactly when modal .2 holds. Over C5, propositional separation by Boolean observers preserving the universal quantifier at t is equivalent to full OS. Over C, either of the accepting, identity-fixing mixed N/Q_t or V/Q_t separation formulas characterizes C5 + OS. The finite-support natural-numbers/singleton all-maps model gives OS with failure of ☐BF_e, ☐BF_t and ☐Functionality at (e,t). Under C5, ☐OS plus one atom is equivalent to endpoint separation; the single boxed propositional Good_{ {t} } separation formula suffices. Reversible logical separation implies No Pure Contingency without atoms or Actuality. The implication from reversible separation to C5 + ☐OS is strict even in atomless models. The finite-block symmetry countermodel makes the pure six-element subset-selection sentence contingent. Reversible separation is equivalently logical separation by necessarily bijective observers; over C it is also separation by invertible universal-preserving observers at finite type lists containing t. Full separation by observers with admitted qualified right inverses is exactly reversible separation. Qualified left-inverse separation is strictly weaker, even with C5 and its own boxed schema; it implies OS but does not imply C5, ☐OS, its own boxed schema, ☐BF or ☐Functionality. Separate full endpoint-fixing M/Q/P, V/Q/P and N/Q/P separation, even with all their boxed instances and boxed BF and Functionality, does not imply Boolean separation: the ternary Cantor model refutes the unrestricted mixed-quantifier reductions. The arrow from qualified left-inverse separation to OS is also strict, and SplitMono is incomparable with ☐OS. Under internal finiteness of all propositions, full SplitMono, Rev and endpoint separation coincide. Even C5 + ☐SplitMono + No Pure Contingency does not imply Rev. Rev implies the stronger noncontingency schema for pure formulas with finitely many individual parameters and endpoint-valued first-order relation parameters. Over C + BF, each fixed-list left-inverse separation instance is equivalent to the corresponding reversible instance or ordinary separation together with one qualified left-inverse pair having a true kernel element. Full H scope gives an external schema of such alternatives, not a global disjunction. If every admitted injective proposition operation is onto, full left-inverse and reversible separation coincide; the two-colour atomless model satisfies this condition and Rev while endpoint separation fails. Over H, endpoint separation is equivalent to OS + Plenitude at (t,t), OS + full Plenitude, C5 + OS + Actuality, C5 + OS + Boolean Completeness, and C5 + Atomicity (type t). Already C + BF (type t) + Plenitude at (t,t) is equivalent to C5 + Actuality. Over C5, each currently surjective Good observer at a finite list containing t has a definable admitted same-list qualified right inverse; hence Rev is equivalent over H to C5 + full surjective logical separation. Both chains Rev ⇒ SurjSep ⇒ OS and Rev ⇒ SplitMono ⇒ OS are strict. SurjSep and SplitMono are incomparable even over C + ☐BF + ☐OS, witnessed by the full omega-chain and the C5 finite-block model. Within C5, SurjSep is Rev and does imply SplitMono. The linear/circular fibre model satisfies C5 + ☐OS + D_t with atomless propositions but fails SplitMono at the explicit propositional list {t,e,et,eet,(et)t,((et)t)t}; a contingent closed pure sentence about infinite amorphous cells proves the obstruction. A specified countably infinite sequence fixed by a source symmetry group in the all-bijections finite-pinning framework gives one qualified left-inverse pair with a true kernel element, normalizing ordinary separators at that source. At the trivial-symmetry object of the qualitative-contrast model, C5 + SplitMono holds but ☐OS and ☐SplitMono fail. Thus SplitMono and ☐OS are incomparable even over C5. Every full cancellative-monoid action model with singleton individuals satisfies separately boxed full SurjSep. A specified infinite sequence of distinct units also gives separately boxed full SplitMono, with one common qualified left inverse. A nonunit refutes C5. The concrete monoid ℤ×ℕ therefore refutes ☐SurjSep + ☐SplitMono ⇒ Rev, even over C + ☐BF. SurjSep + SplitMono lies strictly below Rev and strictly above each factor; its two witness families may be different. Over C + BF (type t), Onto(E) implies ☐Onto(E), with E a free parameter; Good qualification is persistent over C. Full SurjSep nevertheless gives neither ☐OS nor ☐SurjSep, even with ☐BF and ☐Functionality. A root truth-profile extension of a fixed/free symmetry tail supplies this countermodel, with failure already at the future propositional Boolean instance. Thus Rev ⇒ ☐SurjSep ⇒ SurjSep and ☐SurjSep ⇒ ☐OS are strict. SurjSep does not imply ☐BF, with failure at every admitted type in the integer-shift predecessor model. Over C5, every admitted Good-{t} observer E has admitted order adjoints L ⊣ E ⊣ R, with Rq=∃p[(Ep≤q)∧p] and Lq=¬R(¬q). With k=RBottom and a=¬k, R(Ep)=p∨k and L(Ep)=p∧a, giving a Boolean order isomorphism from [Bottom,a] onto the admitted image. Injectivity is equivalent to RBottom=Bottom or LTop=Top; onto is equivalent to join preservation by R or meet preservation by L; bijectivity is equivalent to R=L or negation preservation by either adjoint. The admitted image floor ER and ceiling EL are idempotent, with ER≤I≤EL and mutual absorption. ER is an auxiliary S5 interior and equals native Box exactly when E is endpoint-valued. The endpoint-fixing envelopes T−q=(a∧Rq)∨(k∧q) and T+q=Lq∨(k∧q) preserve M/all Q and V/all P respectively, and coincide exactly when E is onto. Already for a Boolean E over C5, commuting with native Box or Diamond is exactly injectivity, without Q_t. The integer-shift predecessor model satisfies C + full typed SurjSep + BF while ☐BF_σ fails at every admitted type σ. In the finite-pinning tail over ℕ×ℤ and {∗}×ℤ, split epimorphisms approximate finite pins and invertible integer translations supply prescribed-coordinate kernel pairs. The root truth-profile extension combines all-type evaluation readers with those onto tails. A future object has nononto transport at every type and refutes every BF instance. Hence SurjSep ⇒ ☐BF is refuted with exact all-type scope. Full BoxSep restricts Good separators by the whole native-modality identity E∘Box=Box∘E; InjSep instead requires current injectivity. Over H, BoxSep gives C + OS + ☐BF + ☐Functionality + .2. Locally over C, BF_σ + BoxSep(t,Δ) gives ☐BF_σ when {σ,σt}⊆Δ. The .2 consequence needs only propositional separation by Bottom-fixing observers commuting with native Box, without Boolean or quantifier laws. Over C5, BoxSep(τ,Δ) is equivalent to InjSep(τ,Δ) at the same list, and Rev ⇒ InjSep=BoxSep ⇒ OS has both implications strict. Over C+BF, BoxSep is incomparable with InjSep and SplitMono; over C+☐BF it is incomparable with ☐OS. It implies neither C5 nor its own necessary schema. The linear/circular model refutes the entire converse OS+☐BF+☐Functionality+.2 ⇒ BoxSep. For an arbitrary admitted E over C, ☐Inj(E) is equivalent to an admitted unqualified whole left inverse; the description D_E(q)=∀p[(Ep=q)→p] supplies it without BF or Choice. Current injectivity does not suffice outside C5, even for an individually full-Good observer with necessary BF. Over C5, fix injective Good_Δ E with t∈Δ and admitted adjoints L⊣E⊣R. Put C_E=E∘L. Qualified left inverses F correspond bijectively to admitted propositions u satisfying C_E(u)=Top and ∀q[u∧C_E(u∧q)=u∧q], via F_u(q)=L(u∧q) and u_F=¬k_F. The proof uses Frobenius L(q∧Ep)=Lq∧p and the Boolean isomorphism p↦u∧Ep onto [Bottom,u], with all admitted quantifier laws. No Choice or external completeness is assumed. The full-function C5 model on 2×RO(Cantor²) has an injective all-type Good cylinder embedding with no qualified Good-t left inverse, although its admitted adjoints are unqualified left inverses. This model fails OS(t,{t}); it does not refute InjSep⇒SplitMono. SplitMono strictly implies InjSep, even over C5 with necessary all-type Relational Choice, Transversal Choice and Zorn. IdemBoxSep adds the whole identity E∘E=E to BoxSep. Over H, IdemBoxSep⇒BoxSep is strict, C5+IdemBoxSep is equivalent to Extensionality, and IdemBoxSep is incomparable with Rev and End; either conjunction with IdemBoxSep is Extensionality. In a full model with singleton individuals on a finite rooted poset P, Boolean observers are exactly inflationary coordinate maps E_f=f⁻¹; native-Box commutation is f[↑x]=↑f(x), and idempotence is f²=f. An idempotent native-Box reader of a is exactly x↦x∨a. Thus full IdemBoxSep holds exactly when P is a join-semilattice, and then holds necessarily. In the four-level family root<A_m<B_n<top, for positive finite m,n, BoxSep iff m=1 or n≤m, while IdemBoxSep iff m=1 or n=1. P_{2,2} gives strictness; P_{2,3} refutes BoxSep despite ☐OS+☐BF+☐Functionality+☐Atomicity_t+☐.2. The diamond has ☐IdemBoxSep but fails .3 and C5. A singleton root below a terminal two-point cluster has current IdemBoxSep but fails its boxed schema. Over C5, for each relational τ and finite Δ containing t, InjSep(τ,Δ) iff RevSep(τ,Δ) or (OS(τ,Δ) and J_Δ). J_Δ asserts one admitted injective Good_Δ E and one currently true c with R_Ec=Bottom, equivalently ∀p(Ep≤c→p=Bottom). The Boolean patch (c∧Gp)∨(¬c∧Ep) normalizes every ordinary G to an injective Good observer while preserving its entire current truth profile. The reverse alternative uses an admitted local interval involution, without treating L_E as globally Good. K_Δ implies J_Δ. Under C5, same-observer quantifier reduction and Functionality reduce full OS, InjSep, Rev and SplitMono to their single propositional Good-{t} instances. Consequently full InjSep iff Rev or (OS and J_{t}), and full SplitMono iff Rev or (OS and K_{t}), as genuine finite disjunctions. The rigid Souslin model refutes OS+J_t ⇒ Rev or K_t over C5. The earlier regular-open model refutes J_t⇒K_t alone and fails OS. The general C+BF decomposition retains its finite-list schema. Over C+BoxSep(t,{t}), A→☐A holds for every finite universally closed parameter-free Boolean/native-modal sentence A=∀p̄ θ(p̄), with quantifier-free θ. More generally it holds for ∀R̄ φ(R̄) in the specified equality-free first-order modal fragment: predicate heads are only the outer variables, applied only to object-variable tuples; inner object quantifiers may be universal or existential at any admitted type, but object variables are not bare asserted propositions. Δ includes every outer predicate type and inner binder type. No inner quantified predicate head or other predicate constant is allowed. This gives the finite BF reflection and conditional .3→☐.3 and 5→☐5, not .3 or 5. Unconditional C equivalence transfers the theorem to equivalent modal-algebra statements. Arbitrary ∀p∃q with q asserted as a proposition is outside the theorem. C+BF_t+.2 already implies ☐.2. A four-point root/singleton/two-point-cluster model has C+☐OS+☐BF+☐Functionality and current ∀p(☐◇p→◇☐p) but not its necessity; it fails .2, so it does not separate reflection from the entire lower bundle. For each fixed external r≥1, B_r adds E^(r+1)=E^r to the native-Box logical qualification. B_1 is IdemBoxSep, and B_1⇒B_2⇒…⇒BoxSep has every successive implication strict; each fixed B_r strictly implies BoxSep. The separately boxed hierarchy is strict too. P_{3,2} witnesses the first step; for r≥2, a root followed by r two-point antichains and a top has ☐B_{r+1} but not B_r. On P_{m,n}, B_2 iff m=1 or n=1 or m>n; B_3 iff BoxSep. All witnesses retain C+☐OS+☐BF+☐Functionality+☐Atomicity_t+☐.2. One infinite frame with countably many two-point antichains and a common top has ☐BoxSep but fails every fixed B_r, witnessed by the same proposition pair. An admitted Q_t diagonal excludes all nonprincipal observer characters, extending the coordinate-reader and IdemBoxSep/join criteria to rooted posets of fixed finite external width. For every fixed r, C5+B_r, Rev+B_r and End+B_r are exactly Extensionality; B_r is incomparable with Rev and End. Over C5 and each fixed external n≥0, FG_n(E) says that the Boolean image of E plus n admitted propositions generates the ambient proposition algebra. A Good observer with a currently true local Boolean transversal has a qualified involution with its entire current truth profile, without an injectivity premise. FG_n supplies such a transversal, so separation by Good+FG_n observers is exactly Rev, at fixed τ,Δ containing t and at full scope with C5 retained; adding injectivity leaves the equivalence unchanged. For an individual injective FG_n observer, the controlled selector gives a qualified left inverse and can make Fc=Bottom whenever R_Ec=Bottom. Consequently K_Δ is exactly J_Δ with a one-generator image extension, equivalently J_Δ with FG_n for any fixed n≥1. J is an admitted relative logical embedding into a currently false principal interval; K is the corresponding relative logical isomorphism with an admitted inverse. The unchanged full-function C5 model on 2×RO(Cantor²) refutes J⇒K. Its clopen-partition embedding witnesses J and even has a qualified left inverse, but that inverse has a false greatest kernel, and every Good-t observer preserves current truth, ruling out K. OS fails in that regular-open model. The rigid Souslin model separately refutes OS+J_t⇒Rev∨K_t and InjSep⇒SplitMono. The displayed embedding fails every fixed FG_n condition. The full exterior-arm poset A_{m,n} always has B_2 at its root. Its future P_{m,n} cone gives exact thresholds: ☐B_2 iff m=1 or n=1 or m>n; for fixed r≥3, ☐B_r iff ☐BoxSep iff m=1 or n≤m. A_{2,2} has B_2+☐B_3 but not ☐B_2. The single ten-point A_{2,3} has B_2 but not ☐BoxSep, and B_r but not ☐B_r for every fixed r≥2, retaining C+☐OS+☐BF+☐Functionality+☐Atomicity_t+☐.2. B_1 is hereditary within full finite-width poset models by the join criterion, not in general preorder models. Over C5, every Good_Δ observer E, with t∈Δ, has admitted local-transversal support s_E=∃b(Loc_E(b)∧b), using an endpoint locality guard defined by whole unary identity. Locality is injection of L_E on [Bottom,b]. The support is the maximal region whose every nonzero part contains a nonzero local transversal. An admitted join is local exactly when every pair of its members has local union; directed admitted families glue. The exact laws are Loc_{F∘E}(b) iff Loc_F(b) and Loc_E(L_F b), s_{F∘E}=s_F∧F(s_E), and s_G=(d∧s_E)∨(¬d∧s_F) for the Boolean patch G=dE∨¬dF. N(E)(p)=(s_E∧Ep)∨(¬s_E∧p) retracts the Good class onto its composition-closed support-Top subclass. Separation by full-support observers, by true-support observers, or by the admitted range of N is exactly Rev over C5 at fixed and full scope. No injectivity is assumed. Full support is strictly broader than each fixed FG_n for individuals and need not itself be local or imply an individual inverse. Under the additional current unboxed premises C5+BC_t+Zorn_t, any Good E and proposition r admit a maximal local u≤r with L_Eu=L_E(s_E∧r). BC_t supplies actual joins of current chain members; C_E is left adjoint to ER_E, so compatible locality survives those joins; Zorn_t supplies maximality. With injection added, a qualified left inverse exists iff L_Es_E=Top, and one killing a prescribed c exists iff L_E(s_E∧¬c)=Top. Thus K is exactly an injective Good observer with a currently true c and this controlled support coverage. A J witness with full support gives K under these premises, but J alone only gives L_E¬c=Top. Neither optional premise is necessitated, and no uniform choice is claimed. Over C5, TrueHom means that a currently true principal interval admits relative order isomorphisms to all its nonzero principal subintervals, with admitted inverses. Those witnesses preserve every requested quantifier. TrueHom implies Actuality or K; the atomic branch plus OS gives End and Rev, while the nonatomic branch gives a false-interval isomorphism and true-kernel inverse pair. Consequently C5+OS+TrueHom implies SplitMono without J. An admitted homogeneous cover with join Top suffices for TrueHom. External homogeneity alone does not. This sufficient condition does not resolve the general OS+J⇒Rev∨K question. Over C5, for every fixed external n≥1, Deg_n(E) says that n+1 disjoint propositions have L_E-images with zero common intersection. For arbitrary Good_Δ E with t∈Δ, without injection, this implies full local support and an admitted qualified involution with the same entire current truth profile. Degree-bounded separation is exactly Rev at fixed and full scope; degree one is exactly surjectivity. Degree bounds multiply under composition and add under Boolean patching. Under the additional current BC_t+Zorn_t premises, degree at most n is exactly a partition of Top into n local transversals, allowing zero sheets. FG_k implies Deg_{2^k} over C5 alone, and the reverse holds with BC_t+Zorn_t. All bounds are fixed external integers, not finite range or an internal quantifier over finite bounds. For every fixed relational τ and finite Δ, over C, Actuality+FinBoxSep(τ,Δ) iff Fin_t(All)+BoxSep(τ,Δ), with no t∈Δ, BF, Functionality, C5 or Choice added. FinBoxSep requires internally Frege-finite image of the same Good/native-Box observers. An observer accepting an actual world has identity's current truth profile; native-Box commutation makes it injective, and internal finite-preimage induction gives finite All. Conversely finite image induction and a finite true-meet fold give the other direction and Actuality. Full schema scope recovers C over H. In every full set-sized rooted-poset action model with singleton individuals, FinBoxSep iff the frame is finite and BoxSep holds, at arbitrary width; no infinite-width observer classification is used. Cent_Δ(E) means Good_Δ E and whole commutation with every admitted same-list Good G. Over C with unary Functionality, Boolean patches force idempotence. Over C5+S_{t,Δ}, t∈Δ, a central observer is identity or an endpoint observer with a currently true greatest kernel, with at most one nonidentity possibility. Central separation excludes that possibility using its true atomic kernel and the corresponding endpoint observer. Thus C5+CentreSep is exactly Extensionality, already from its propositional instance with t∈Δ. Full CentreSep+Rev and CentreSep+End also equal Extensionality. CentreSep is incomparable with Rev and End over H: a two-point chain has ☐CentreSep but fails C5, while a two-point S5 cluster has Rev and End but not CentreSep. In full finite rooted-poset models with singleton individuals, the centre is identity plus the constant-top map when top exists, so CentreSep holds exactly on a singleton or two-point chain. This is not merely a chosen pairwise commuting family or an abstract H classification. The unchanged atomless two-colour finite-pinning model additionally has ☐BC_t with C5+☐Rev+D_t, but fails Actuality, End, BC_tt and Zorn_t. Actual joins of stabilizer orbits are their finite fixed-pin projections, and finitely many such projections join the current extension of any admitted predicate. An admitted preorder of finite colour-coordinate joins refutes the single Zorn_t instance: finite pins bound all admitted antisymmetric chains, but fresh coordinates prevent maximal elements. The model therefore does not refute any conclusion with BC_t and Zorn_t jointly added. The exact type specialization of the recorded completeness proof gives C5+BC_tt⇒Plen_{t,t}⇒Actuality; with OS it gives End. Over C5, S_{t,Δ}+BC_σ implies ☐BC_σ when Δ contains σ and σt. Observers fix endpoint order judgments and postcompose the family predicate; current completeness and separation then identify BC_σ with Top. The C5 Good-t reduction permits the single S_{t,{t}} instance and full OS. This reflects each assumed instance, not a lift from BC_t to higher completeness. Over C5, full Rev is equivalent to the single finite sentence that only Bottom and Top are fixed by every reversible Good-t observer. The admitted join of reversible images is the least invariant proposition above an input. The same invariants are exactly the propositions respected by every logical observer on its local-transversal support, equivalently fixed by every support-normalized observer. Over H, full CentreSep is exactly IdemBoxSep plus at most four proposition objects and is equivalent to its separately boxed schema. Separation by the centre of the reversible logical group is exactly C5 plus the same four-proposition bound, is persistent, and is incomparable with CentreSep; their conjunction is Extensionality. For fixed external n≥1, Rev plus the whole identity E^n=I for every reversible Good-t observer is exactly C5 plus at most 2^k propositions, where k is the largest integer such that each of 1,…,k divides n. Finite common refinement supplies admitted cycles of each prescribed finite length. Full FinBoxSep is equivalent over H to BoxSep plus internal Frege finiteness of all propositions, and implies Actuality and necessary finiteness. Over C the fixed-instance equivalence needs any relational type in the finite qualification list; empty and individual-only lists remain unresolved without Actuality. C5 or Rev together with FinBoxSep is exactly End plus internal finiteness. FinBoxSep does not imply its boxed schema even with necessary global finiteness, as witnessed by the finite exterior-arm model. For every fixed nonempty reduced group word w, H+Rev+Law_w is exactly C5+AtMost_(2^k(w))(t), equivalently End plus that bound, where k(w) is the largest j for which Sym(j) satisfies w and 1≤k(w)≤length(w). Commutativity gives four propositions and the metabelian word gives eight. Over C5 without Rev, Law_w is exactly the condition that no k(w)+1 disjoint propositions have invariant orbit joins with nonzero common meet. Finitely many targets admit common reversible nonzero refinements exactly when their orbit joins overlap; finite invariant localization proves the converse group-law direction without Choice, BC or Zorn. Over H, an internally Frege-finite admitted observer family separating an admitted proposition class makes that class internally finite. The independent finite-table theorem counts admitted functions on finite input/output predicates under an identifying evaluation premise; Functionality supplies that premise for a full input domain. H+Rev+Fin_tt(Aut_Good_t), C5+FinAll, End+FinAll and C5+FinBoxSep are equivalent. Full finite-family ordinary logical separation is OS+FinAll; its reversible version is C5+FinAll; its native-Box version is FinBoxSep. Over H, OS plus existence of a correct actual-truth evaluator is equivalent to endpoint separation. Over C, endpoint separation is equivalent to necessary existence of a unique correct evaluator and to ☐Plenitude; existence of one evaluator necessarily correct at every world is equivalent to Extensionality. Over C, if S_pt is propositional separation by pointwise conjunction-preserving involutions, Rev is equivalent to ☐S_pt and to S_pt + BF_t. Moving the observer witness outside the necessity operator gives Extensionality. S_pt + OneAtom is equivalent to ND_t + Atomicity_t. The original first-order endpoint-parameter noncontingency schema does not imply Rev, even with C5 + ☐SplitMono. Over C5 the stronger schema for endpoint-valued families invariant under admitted surjective order automorphisms is equivalent to Rev. A finite-partition model satisfies ☐OS but has an admitted proper propositional filter with no admitted ultrafilter extension.
intake.scope: Observers preserve Boolean and quantifier operations by identities between the composite operations, at each finite list of types. Endpoint observers satisfy ∀p(Ep = ⊤ ∨ Ep = ⊥); factive observers satisfy ∀p(Ep → p). Over C, the single propositional endpoint-separation instance testing quantifiers at t already characterizes C5 + Atomicity (type t), and its separately boxed form is equivalent. Over H, the recovery of C uses the full typed schema. The equality laws are redundant over C; they support the H proof transformation. Finite image is expressed by the database’s Frege FiniteCardinality at t, with no common bound and no assumption that internal finiteness has an externally finite extension. The single finite-image witness need not itself separate. Endpoint truth follows from Boolean preservation over H, and endpoint identity over C. Including explicit endpoint identities gives an equivalent full separation theory over H, although standalone qualification there can be stronger. The conjunction/universal comparisons concern propositional separation; the displayed strict witnesses test type t. Relational extension requires Functionality. Fixing identity judgments means the full composite identity (λp,q.E(p=q))=(λp,q.p=q). This fragment differs from identity-fixing logical separation, which is C5 + OS. The comparisons form a proved fragment; reversible separation is strictly stronger than C5 + ☐OS, including in the atomless case. The H observer atlas records the full typed factorization and independent-primitive distinctions separately. The reduction to Q_t assumes C5 and uses full composite identities. The endpoint-parameter schema covers relations of types eⁿt with n ≥ 1, not arbitrary higher-type parameters. The component-shift countermodel uses a restricted group of arrows, so it does not contradict the one-object all-bijections sufficient theorem. The adjoint tests concern individual observers over C5, not separation principles. The native modal commutation criterion needs Boolean qualification only; the adjoints require Good-{t}. Their construction uses admitted families and lambda terms, with no external completeness or Choice. The integer-shift model has current BF at its root, not necessary BF; its negative verdict holds at every admitted type. BoxSep refers to native necessity and a whole operation identity, not the auxiliary image closure. The finite Barcan transport uses σ and σt; the minimal .2 theorem retains C. The selector classification is for one injective Good_Δ observer over C5 with t∈Δ. Its nonsplitting model fails OS and is not a separation-theory countermodel. The join and antichain thresholds characterize the specified full finite rooted-poset models, not general abstract theories. The C5 compression alone justifies the full-schema finite disjunction. Reflection retains the exact syntactic grammar and finite qualification list; .3 and 5 conclusions are conditional. Necessary .2 is already a consequence of C+BF_t+.2. Iteration bounds r, generator bounds n and finite frame widths are external finite parameters, not internal Frege finiteness or quantified bounds. Finite-relative-generation separation equivalence retains C5 and requires no injectivity; controlled individual inverses require injection. The J/¬K countermodel fails OS and does not settle the separation implication. Local support is defined by an admitted endpoint guard, not by a join of the current extension of an arbitrary predicate. The selection theorem retains both current BC_t and Zorn_t; its inverse criteria add injectivity. TrueHom retains admitted relative isomorphisms and inverses. The finite-poset inheritance statements are model-family facts, not general persistence theorems. Fibre-degree and generator bounds are fixed external parameters. BC_t and Zorn_t enter the global sheet theorem, not degree-profile normalization. The arbitrary-list FinBoxSep theorem retains Actuality; the stronger reflection theorem removes it when the list contains any relational type and at full scope. Centrality quantifies over every same-list Good observer. The colour model fails Zorn_t and supplies no joint-BC_t-plus-Zorn_t countermodel; completeness reflection keeps the same type instance. The invariant and exponent predicates qualify at t and use the C5 same-observer type reduction. Centrality quantifies over every qualified observer in the specified whole class; group centrality restricts both the observer and the commutation range to reversible members at the same finite list. Four and the exponent bounds count proposition objects with fixed external integers, distinct from unbounded internal Frege finiteness. The exponent law constrains every reversible observer, not only chosen separators. Local-support detection yields a qualified inverse only with BC at t, Zorn at t and the additional support-coverage equation. SplitMono strictly implies InjSep, even over C5 with necessary all-type Relational Choice, Transversal Choice and Zorn. Group-word laws quantify every finite tuple of admitted qualified inverse pairs and assert whole-operation identity; the word and its bound are fixed externally. The component theorem uses the admitted orbit join and does not assert a global domain bound without Rev. Internal Frege finiteness is distinct from each fixed numerical bound; finite-family schemas supply a separate existential family at each fixed output type and finite list.
intake.integration_action: Use composite operation identities. Record H + OS ⇒ C + BF; endpoint separation ⇔ C5 + Atomicity (type t) and factive separation ⇔ Extensionality over H, for the full typed schemas. Preserve the stronger single-instance reductions over C. Record the strict hierarchy, the Atomicity (type t) + BF sufficient condition and the C5 + Actuality equivalence. Separations belong in model records. Under OS, uniqueness of the qualified logical observer characterizes Extensionality.

intake.title: Theoremhood and model construction have successive jump thresholds
intake.statement:
The positive theories, Max and SP occupy three successive levels of computational strength.

| Pure theory | Theoremhood | Oracles computing some adequate countable model |
|---|---|---|
| C + ☐Plenitude + Axiom of Infinity (types e and t) | $\Sigma^0_1$-complete | PA degrees |
| C + ☐Functional Choice + Axiom of Infinity (types e and t) | $\Sigma^0_1$-complete | PA degrees |
| Max | $\Sigma^0_2$-complete | PA degrees over $0'$ |
| SP, **if consistent** | $\Sigma^0_3$-complete | PA degrees over $0''$ |

Adequate codes provide term interpretation and actual truth. PA degree over an oracle means the ability to compute a binary diagonally nonrecursive function relative to it; ordinary PA degrees use no oracle. The positive bounds already hold with the weaker Infinity schema at one admitted type. The theoremhood classifications persist under consistent extensions enumerable in the corresponding oracle.
intake.scope: The original pure finitary relational language and fixed reference C are used throughout. Completeness is under ordinary computable many-one reductions. Model capacity means computing some countable BBK model with sorted domains, equality, uniform finite-term interpretation and actual truth. No bound for a bare action/category presentation is inferred. All SP existence and complexity conclusions require Con(SP).

Conjoining separately separating classes can be strictly weaker than requiring one class to satisfy both qualifications. The accompanying representation theorems characterize the connective, quantifier and equality branches with their explicit premises. Reversible accepting/rejecting meet separation plus one atom makes atoms separate order, represents every proposition as the join of its atoms, and gives a unique true atom. Under internal Frege finiteness of all propositions, material and pointwise meet separation are equivalent, and likewise for join separation, retaining each acceptance/rejection orientation. Full relational separation collapses all three tiers. A least true meet element or greatest false join element suffices for the corresponding normalization without finiteness. A six-element model shows that atomisticity and a true atom alone do not suffice. For each finite preservation signature, pointwise separation is equivalent to the existence of an admitted composition-closed separating family of material observers, equivalently such a composition-closed family containing identity. Finite-image material meet separation is equivalent to at-most-two-output pointwise meet separation, and likewise for join, without finiteness of the proposition domain. Full typed OS need not imply ☐BF or ☐Functionality. Endpoint logical separation is equivalent to C5 + ☐OS + one atom, and already to C5 plus the boxed propositional Good_{ {t} } separation instance plus one atom. Reversible logical separation implies C5 + ☐OS + No Pure Contingency, with no atom or Actuality premise. The proof extends qualified involutions by typewise conjugation and applies separation to each closed pure sentence. Reversible logical separation is strictly stronger than C5 + ☐OS, even among atomless models: the even-block/power-of-two-block symmetry model has necessary OS but a contingent closed pure six-element selection sentence. Over H + ND (type t), material and pointwise meet/universal separation have the same exact meet/GLB representation, with a dual join/existential result. Finite-image normalization extends to matching quantifiers and joint M,V,Q,P packages. Over C, an admitted whole inverse is equivalent to necessary bijectivity; invertible Q_t observers are automatically Boolean. Local stabilizer conjugacy supplies reversible observers in the stated symmetry-model families. Internal Frege finiteness also gives exact affine representation by two-output pointwise homomorphisms, separately for XOR and biconditional. Finite-image material affine separation has the same normalization without finiteness of the domain. Plenitude at (t,t), stated explicitly over H, normalizes all seven nonempty primitive connective signatures, each affine operation, and the verified matching lattice/quantifier packages, including infinite-image observers. Full qualified right-inverse separation is exactly Rev. Qualified left-inverse separation is strictly weaker even with C5 and its own boxed schema; it implies OS, but not C5, ☐OS, its own boxed schema, ☐BF or ☐Functionality. Zorn at tt also supplies admitted prime filters and extension of admitted partial lattice truth characters over H; material joint lattice and Boolean separation have exact algebraic converses under this explicit premise, with the stated endpoint alignments and derived operations. Over bare H, joint negation/affine material separation is exactly affine separation plus the translation identity ¬x=x+c, c=¬0. Joint XOR/biconditional separation is exactly XOR separation plus the corresponding translated-operation identity. Under the actual expansion X=¬D, all three two-operation material packages agree with the three-operation package; Plenitude supplies pointwise involutions for the linked signatures. Over C + BF, at each finite list Δ containing t and relational output type τ, SplitMonoSep(τ,Δ) is equivalent to RevSep(τ,Δ) or [OS(τ,Δ) and KΔ], where KΔ asserts one admitted qualified pair F∘E=I and a true c with Fc=Bottom. N(E)(p)=(s_E∧Ep)∨(¬s_E∧p) retracts the Good class onto its composition-closed support-Top subclass. Separation by full-support observers, by true-support observers, or by the admitted range of N is exactly Rev over C5 at fixed and full scope. No injectivity is assumed. Full support is strictly broader than each fixed FG_n for individuals and need not itself be local or imply an individual inverse. Under the additional current unboxed premises C5+BC_t+Zorn_t, any Good E and proposition r admit a maximal local u≤r with L_Eu=L_E(s_E∧r). BC_t supplies actual joins of current chain members; C_E is left adjoint to ER_E, so compatible locality survives those joins; Zorn_t supplies maximality. With injection added, a qualified left inverse exists iff L_Es_E=Top, and one killing a prescribed c exists iff L_E(s_E∧¬c)=Top. Thus K is exactly an injective Good observer with a currently true c and this controlled support coverage. A J witness with full support gives K under these premises, but J alone only gives L_E¬c=Top. Neither optional premise is necessitated, and no uniform choice is claimed. Over C5, TrueHom means that a currently true principal interval admits relative order isomorphisms to all its nonzero principal subintervals, with admitted inverses. Those witnesses preserve every requested quantifier. TrueHom implies Actuality or K; the atomic branch plus OS gives End and Rev, while the nonatomic branch gives a false-interval isomorphism and true-kernel inverse pair. Consequently C5+OS+TrueHom implies SplitMono without J. An admitted homogeneous cover with join Top suffices for TrueHom. External homogeneity alone does not. This sufficient condition does not resolve the general OS+J⇒Rev∨K question. Over C5, for every fixed external n≥1, Deg_n(E) says that n+1 disjoint propositions have L_E-images with zero common intersection. For arbitrary Good_Δ E with t∈Δ, without injection, this implies full local support and an admitted qualified involution with the same entire current truth profile. Degree-bounded separation is exactly Rev at fixed and full scope; degree one is exactly surjectivity. Degree bounds multiply under composition and add under Boolean patching. Under the additional current BC_t+Zorn_t premises, degree at most n is exactly a partition of Top into n local transversals, allowing zero sheets. FG_k implies Deg_{2^k} over C5 alone, and the reverse holds with BC_t+Zorn_t. All bounds are fixed external integers, not finite range or an internal quantifier over finite bounds. For every fixed relational τ and finite Δ, over C, Actuality+FinBoxSep(τ,Δ) iff Fin_t(All)+BoxSep(τ,Δ), with no t∈Δ, BF, Functionality, C5 or Choice added. FinBoxSep requires internally Frege-finite image of the same Good/native-Box observers. An observer accepting an actual world has identity's current truth profile; native-Box commutation makes it injective, and internal finite-preimage induction gives finite All. Conversely finite image induction and a finite true-meet fold give the other direction and Actuality. Full schema scope recovers C over H. In every full set-sized rooted-poset action model with singleton individuals, FinBoxSep iff the frame is finite and BoxSep holds, at arbitrary width; no infinite-width observer classification is used. Cent_Δ(E) means Good_Δ E and whole commutation with every admitted same-list Good G. Over C with unary Functionality, Boolean patches force idempotence. Over C5+S_{t,Δ}, t∈Δ, a central observer is identity or an endpoint observer with a currently true greatest kernel, with at most one nonidentity possibility. Central separation excludes that possibility using its true atomic kernel and the corresponding endpoint observer. Thus C5+CentreSep is exactly Extensionality, already from its propositional instance with t∈Δ. Full CentreSep+Rev and CentreSep+End also equal Extensionality. CentreSep is incomparable with Rev and End over H: a two-point chain has ☐CentreSep but fails C5, while a two-point S5 cluster has Rev and End but not CentreSep. In full finite rooted-poset models with singleton individuals, the centre is identity plus the constant-top map when top exists, so CentreSep holds exactly on a singleton or two-point chain. This is not merely a chosen pairwise commuting family or an abstract H classification. The unchanged atomless two-colour finite-pinning model additionally has ☐BC_t with C5+☐Rev+D_t, but fails Actuality, End, BC_tt and Zorn_t. Actual joins of stabilizer orbits are their finite fixed-pin projections, and finitely many such projections join the current extension of any admitted predicate. An admitted preorder of finite colour-coordinate joins refutes the single Zorn_t instance: finite pins bound all admitted antisymmetric chains, but fresh coordinates prevent maximal elements. The model therefore does not refute any conclusion with BC_t and Zorn_t jointly added. The exact type specialization of the recorded completeness proof gives C5+BC_tt⇒Plen_{t,t}⇒Actuality; with OS it gives End. Over C5, S_{t,Δ}+BC_σ implies ☐BC_σ when Δ contains σ and σt. Observers fix endpoint order judgments and postcompose the family predicate; current completeness and separation then identify BC_σ with Top. The C5 Good-t reduction permits the single S_{t,{t}} instance and full OS. This reflects each assumed instance, not a lift from BC_t to higher completeness. Over C5, full Rev is equivalent to the single finite sentence that only Bottom and Top are fixed by every reversible Good-t observer. The admitted join of reversible images is the least invariant proposition above an input. The same invariants are exactly the propositions respected by every logical observer on its local-transversal support, equivalently fixed by every support-normalized observer. Over H, full CentreSep is exactly IdemBoxSep plus at most four proposition objects and is equivalent to its separately boxed schema. Separation by the centre of the reversible logical group is exactly C5 plus the same four-proposition bound, is persistent, and is incomparable with CentreSep; their conjunction is Extensionality. For fixed external n≥1, Rev plus the whole identity E^n=I for every reversible Good-t observer is exactly C5 plus at most 2^k propositions, where k is the largest integer such that each of 1,…,k divides n. Finite common refinement supplies admitted cycles of each prescribed finite length. Full FinBoxSep is equivalent over H to BoxSep plus internal Frege finiteness of all propositions, and implies Actuality and necessary finiteness. Over C the fixed-instance equivalence needs any relational type in the finite qualification list; empty and individual-only lists remain unresolved without Actuality. C5 or Rev together with FinBoxSep is exactly End plus internal finiteness. FinBoxSep does not imply its boxed schema even with necessary global finiteness, as witnessed by the finite exterior-arm model. For every fixed nonempty reduced group word w, H+Rev+Law_w is exactly C5+AtMost_(2^k(w))(t), equivalently End plus that bound, where k(w) is the largest j for which Sym(j) satisfies w and 1≤k(w)≤length(w). Commutativity gives four propositions and the metabelian word gives eight. Over C5 without Rev, Law_w is exactly the condition that no k(w)+1 disjoint propositions have invariant orbit joins with nonzero common meet. Finitely many targets admit common reversible nonzero refinements exactly when their orbit joins overlap; finite invariant localization proves the converse group-law direction without Choice, BC or Zorn. Over H, an internally Frege-finite admitted observer family separating an admitted proposition class makes that class internally finite. The independent finite-table theorem counts admitted functions on finite input/output predicates under an identifying evaluation premise; Functionality supplies that premise for a full input domain. H+Rev+Fin_tt(Aut_Good_t), C5+FinAll, End+FinAll and C5+FinBoxSep are equivalent. Full finite-family ordinary logical separation is OS+FinAll; its reversible version is C5+FinAll; its native-Box version is FinBoxSep.

intake.title: Observer interpretations: preservation, realization and uniqueness
intake.statement: A whole-idempotent logical observer in a general C model defines a general C model by normalized objects and their fixed-test quotient. Functional Choice descends in both its current and necessary forms; necessary Boolean Completeness descends instancewise. Every general C model has a proper observer realization preserving its signature and individuals, with a doubled proposition algebra; full current and necessary Boolean Completeness are preserved separately. Every model of C + ☐Functional Choice has such a proper realization within that same theory. Under BF, equal proposition images yield isomorphic pure interpretations. Without BF, this fails even with ☐Atomicity and ☐Boolean Completeness at every relational type. Current Relational Choice and Transversal Choice can fail to descend even from C5 + OS; Actuality repairs endpoint descent under full current Relational Choice. General interpretations need not inherit current BF or current Boolean Completeness. Any set-sized family of pointed C action models can be realized as separate interpretations in one source satisfying OS + Strong Actuality + Zorn, even pure Max(C).
intake.scope: One admitted observer preserves Boolean operations and every typed quantifier as whole identities and satisfies E∘E=E. The type qualification is metatheoretic. Properness concerns its image. The same-image countermodel fails BF_t and hence OS; it does not refute the positive OS comparison. Compatible named expansions are distinguished from pure canonicity. Necessary Functional Choice descends instancewise over bare C; no Infinity or external fullness is assumed. The universal family theorem concerns action models; individual proper doubling covers arbitrary general/Henkin C models. The current-completeness countermodel has C + BC_all + ☐BF_all + ☐OS, with an interpretation satisfying C5 + OS + ¬BC_t; it does not retract C5 endpoint completeness transfer.

intake.title: Modalized Relational Choice supplies its own necessity
intake.statement: Over C, full Modalized Relational Choice is equivalent to its necessary form, to ☐Relational Choice + Intensional Choice, and to ☐Relational Choice + ☐Intensional Choice. Instancewise MRC_(τt,τ) entails ☐MRC_(σ,τ), ☐RC_(σ,τ) and ☐IC_τ. BF_(σt) suffices for IC_σ ⇒ ☐IC_σ; BF_(στt) suffices for MRC_(σ,τ) ⇒ ☐MRC_(σ,τ). Under either full current Boolean Completeness or ☐Vicinity, MRC is also equivalent to Modal Well-Ordering; the latter equivalence holds in particular over C5.
intake.scope: IC here is Intensional Choice, not Infinitary Comprehension; RC is Relational Choice. ND is unnecessary for positive propagation, but is retained in the older theorem that the negations are rigid too. The current-completeness result uses BC_(σt)+MRC_(σt,σ) to obtain a necessarily valid transversal for any necessarily equivalent relation at σ; a single BC_((σt)t) and MRC_((σt)t,σt) suffice for Modal Well-Ordering at σ. More sharply, BC_(σt)+MRC_(σt,σ)+IC_(σσt) implies ☐TC_σ, so full MRC needs only current BC_(σt) for this target. Under IC at the relational input type, modal witnesses for every current input transfer to necessary witness-existence whenever the target formula is invariant under current coextension of that input. With a relational output, its IC instance and output coextension-invariance give the converse.

intake.title: Necessary observers stabilize several analytical claims, but not CH
intake.statement: For one fixed persistent necessarily complete real-field tuple, C5 + ☐OS makes the perfect-set property, real countable choice and real dependent choice noncontingent. Current perfect-set property implies necessary CH for that field. Starting from ZFC with a strongly inaccessible cardinal, an atomless C5 + ☐OS model has a persistent necessarily complete real field and contingent native CH at e. Separately, relative to Con(ZFC), an atomless model of C5 + ☐Rev has that persistent real field, necessary CH and necessary failure of real countable choice.
intake.scope: The real field, its carrier and natural-number predicate are fixed and persistent. Completeness concerns nonempty bounded admitted subproperties. Noncontingency does not assert that the choice principles hold. The contingent-CH construction has an inaccessible hypothesis; no Con(ZFC)-only contingent-CH construction or lower-bound theorem is claimed.

intake.title: Maximalism and propositional completeness give persistent number-set codes
intake.statement: Over C, pure Maximalism + Boolean Completeness at t gives a relative Boolean algebra of proposition codes for exactly the current number sets represented by admitted predicates. An admitted embedding sends each code p to a proposition satisfying p=☐p, including complements relative to the image unit, and preserves every existing join.
intake.scope: Current unboxed Max(C) and BC_t suffice; no OS, Choice, BF, Zorn or global Atomicity is assumed. The result concerns admitted number sets, not an external full power set. Atoms of the relative algebra need not be global proposition atoms. These are distinct statements: the conditional Max(C)+BC_t representation concerns admitted number sets; the external P(N) copy is a verdict of the specified model, for which full Max(C) is not asserted. Numerical Barcan is distinct from ordinary type-ν Barcan.

intake.statement: Finite-alphabet models are atomless C5 + necessary Rev models; CoSep holds exactly for alphabet sizes 2, 3 and 4, and CoIdemSep exactly for size 2. Thus Atomicity and stable CoIdemSep are equivalent, while stable CoIdemSep ⇒ CoIdemSep ⇒ CoSep ⇒ OS are strict implications over C5. The isolated-point model has current CoIdemSep and a stable commuting separating family but not necessary OS. The Bernoulli extension has necessary CoSep without SplitMono or Rev. The supported Boolean root gives OS + .2 without CoSep and separates CoSep from BoxSep and IdemBoxSep; its stronger verified Choice/completeness bounds remain in the proof. The Cohen model retains its separate metatheory and verdicts.

intake.statement: Over C, Actuality + full CoInjSep is equivalent to C5 + full Atomicity + full CoRevSep. Each current member has a qualified inverse in the same family; the package also entails necessary Actuality, CoInjSep, CoRevSep and Plenitude. Its admitted composition closure acts regularly and commutatively on world atoms. A finite-support finite/cofinite model satisfies necessary full Atomicity, Rev and CoIdemSep but has no commuting injective Boolean family determining propositions, even externally. Thus separate CoSep and InjSep do not suffice for CoInjSep. The new inverse lemma is an ordinary proof; the stronger structural consequences use the cited pre-existing C5 results.

intake.statement: Over C, ☐Functional Choice supplies an admitted endpoint-membership family K which necessarily witnesses full CoRevSep, with the same K for every relational output type and finite qualification list. The sharper premise is C5 + Atomicity + an admitted well-order of the world atoms. No quantified Infinity or full standard semantics is needed; the internal construction covers finite, pseudofinite and internally infinite fields. The conclusion is ∃K(Stable(K) ∧ ☐CoRevWitness(K)) instancewise, not merely ☐∃K. The finite/cofinite countermodel necessarily fails Functional Choice at (t,t).
